newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Cogeneration rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cogeneration rated sell.

text.p: Asia Equity on Thursday rated Thai electricity and steam generator Cogeneration Plc a sell.
"We believe the market has grossly overestimated the value of Coco's current and future projects," the broker said in a report.
Asia Equity said its recommendation was based on a revision of revenue contributions from expanded capacity and Cogeneration's decision to defer costs such as depreciation and interest expenses.
The broker has also revised down the size of Cogeneration's planned expansion of capacity to 400 megawatts from 470 MW.
"The effect of these changes is negligible on our valuations for Coco -- although there is a dramatic change in our forecast net profit," Asia Equity said.
"This is because the delay in depreciating and expending interest on new capacity expansion does not affect reported cash flow -- it simply inflates reported earnings."
Asia Equity has revised up its 1997 profit forecast for Cogeneration to 798.1 million baht from 635.9 million baht.
